nodes.description: Internal view function that computes an exchange rate by optionally multiplying and dividing the result of external Chainlink aggregator latestAnswer() calls; core arithmetic/price computation of the oracle.
Pure helper that abi-encodes (multiply, divide, decimals) into the bytes blob consumed by get/peek.
Public state-reading entrypoint: decodes caller supplied calldata into (multiply, divide, decimals) and forwards to _get, returning (true, rate).
View entrypoint identical to get: decodes calldata and forwards to _get to read the latest rate without state changes.
External view wrapper that discards success flag and returns only the rate from peek(data).
View function returning the constant string 'Chainlink'; no external interaction.
View function returning the constant string 'LINK'; no external interaction.
Multiplication price = price.mul(uint256(IAggregator(multiply).latestAnswer())) (or price.mul(1e18)) using BoringMath overflow-checked multiplication inside _get.
Division price = price / uint256(IAggregator(divide).latestAnswer()) inside _get; divisor is fully attacker-supplied oracle output and is not checked for zero.
Final scaling division price / decimals inside _get; decimals is attacker-controlled calldata and a zero value would revert/be manipulable.
External call to the caller-supplied aggregator address (IAggregator(multiply/divide).latestAnswer()) invoked from _get; the target contract is untrusted.
External interface function on the untrusted Chainlink aggregator contract that returns int256 answer and is invoked by _get during rate computation.
address multiply parameter of _get: non-zero value triggers multiplication by that aggregator's latestAnswer().
address divide parameter of _get: non-zero value triggers division by that aggregator's latestAnswer().
uint256 decimals parameter of _get used as the final divisor for scaling the computed price.
Local variable price inside _get, initialised to 1e36 and repeatedly multiplied/divided to produce the final rate.
bytes calldata data parameter of get(), attacker-controlled encoding of (multiply, divide, decimals).
bytes calldata data parameter of peek(), attacker-controlled encoding of (multiply, divide, decimals).
bytes calldata data parameter of peekSpot(), passed through unchanged to peek().

edges.reason: The multiply address parameter selects which untrusted aggregator contract is externally called for latestAnswer().
The divide address parameter selects which untrusted aggregator contract is externally called for latestAnswer().
multiply gates whether the price multiplication with the oracle answer is executed, so it controls the arithmetic path.
The local price variable is the multiplicand updated by price.mul(...).
divide gates whether the division by the second oracle answer is executed.
The local price variable is the dividend divided by the oracle answer.
decimals is the divisor applied to price in the final scaling operation.
The local price variable is the value scaled by the decimals division.
get() decodes its attacker-controlled calldata parameter into multiply, divide and decimals.
peek() decodes its attacker-controlled calldata parameter into multiply, divide and decimals.
peekSpot() forwards its attacker-controlled calldata parameter directly into peek().
get() invokes the internal helper _get() to compute the rate.
peek() invokes the internal helper _get() to compute the rate.
peekSpot() calls peek() and returns only the rate component.
_get() executes the overflow-checked multiplication of price by the oracle answer.
_get() executes the unchecked division of price by the divide aggregator answer.
_get() executes the final division of price by decimals before returning.
_get() performs the external staticcall to the caller-supplied aggregator address to read latestAnswer().

The external call from _get() enters the untrusted aggregator contract at latestAnswer(); a malicious address passed as multiply/divide is invoked during rate computation, enabling reentrancy or manipulation of the oracle path.

normalization_plan.reason: The multiply address parameter exists only to select/be used by the untrusted external aggregator call and its arithmetic branch, so it is folded into that operation node.
The divide address parameter only supplies the divisor via the external aggregator call feeding the division, so it is folded into the division operation node.
The decimals parameter is used solely as the divisor of the final scaling division, so it is folded into that arithmetic operation node.
The local price variable is the accumulator of the mul/div sequence; it is anchored to the first multiplication operation that initialises its value.
The bytes data parameter of get() is only decoded inside get(), so it is folded into the get function node.
The bytes data parameter of peek() is only decoded inside peek(), so it is folded into the peek function node.
The bytes data parameter of peekSpot() is only passed through to peek(), so it is folded into the peekSpot function node.
